headline: Beats on RevPAR and fees; full-year profit guide trimmed
summary_short: Adjusted EPS rose 16% to $2.45 and Adjusted EBITDA rose to $1,058M as system-wide comparable RevPAR grew 5.8%. Full-year Adjusted EBITDA guidance is $4,060M-$4,080M.
summary_long: RevPAR growth came from both occupancy and ADR, and management and franchise fees rose 9.5%. Hilton opened 182 hotels (23,000 net rooms) and its development pipeline reached 543,100 rooms. It repurchased 2.6 million shares for $845M; total capital return in the quarter was $879M. Full-year RevPAR guidance is 4.0%-4.5%, and full-year Adjusted EBITDA guidance reflects lower expectations for the Middle East and timeshare license fees.
confidence_notes: Adjusted EPS and Adjusted EBITDA are non-GAAP measures. Deltas computed from prior-year figures stated in the release ($2.11 adjusted EPS, $1.78 diluted EPS, $421M net income, $976M Adjusted EBITDA). The release says Q3 RevPAR benefited from the World Cup and calendar shifts.

drivers.explanation: Increase in both occupancy and ADR; the release notes the quarter benefited from the World Cup and favorable calendar and holiday shifts.
Management and franchise fee revenues increased 9.5% on RevPAR growth and net unit growth.
CEO cites momentum across the system, the highest quarter ever for organic openings, and confidence in net unit growth around the midpoint of 6.0%-7.0%.
